runtime.image_portability: Local image ID; target registry/archive receipt and validation still required

calculation.inactive_parameter: n-points does not control LeeRichards; do not include it as a tunable production parameter
calculation.area: Absolute per-residue SASA in square angstroms, main chain plus side chain

structure_context.model: Require explicit selected model if multiple; record original model serial and zero-based index; never silently select first or join models
structure_context.chains: Use all declared protein chains of the selected model for occlusion; report mapped design-chain residues; keep other chains fixed. Context must be explicitly accepted for each input; do not infer biological assembly
structure_context.water: Exclude water from the proposed protein context, retain inventory and counts
structure_context.nonprotein: Ligand, metal, nucleic-acid or modified-residue context requires an explicit reviewed profile; do not silently discard by ATOM/HETATM flag
structure_context.hydrogen: Use ProtOr heavy-atom model; exclude H/D by element and retain counts; full atom wording includes all heavy main-chain and side-chain atoms
structure_context.altloc: Require declared conformer selection if disordered; preserve original IDs, do not silently accept parser's default selection
structure_context.occupancy: Retain and report occupancy; no area weighting. Zero/unknown/partial occupancy requires input-context review; do not delete by implicit cutoff
structure_context.unknown_atom: Halt classifier guessing; preserve diagnostics. Affected residue RSA is null and WARNING in a reviewed degradation path; if surrounding occlusion is unvalidated the tool result is unusable, never skip unknown atoms to obtain a successful result
structure_context.missing_atoms: No automatic repair or hydrogen/side-chain generation. Missing coordinate positions use null plus WARNING. CA-only input is not an accepted area reference. Heavy-atom completeness templates/denominator remain OI-023
structure_context.mapping: Only reviewed unique R-58 mappings may feed pipeline; preserve chain_id + auth_resSeq + insertion_code; no positional zip without address verification
structure_context.format: Keep original mmCIF/PDB and hash; any derived PDB needs atom/address/count/coordinate roundtrip. Unrepresentable chain IDs, numbers, MODEL or coordinate fields require explicit mapping/review, never truncation

normalization.table: Tien et al. 2013 Table 1 Theoretical, Gly-X-Gly
normalization.formula: residue absolute SASA / type-specific max ASA
normalization.native_relative_area: Diagnostic only; never used as project RSA
normalization.buried_fraction: count(non-null RSA < 0.20) / full input sequence length
normalization.rounding: No pre-classification rounding; store unrounded values
normalization.missing_or_unknown_residue: null + WARNING; no zero or Gly substitution
normalization.out_of_domain: Finite raw RSA outside [0,1] is a diagnostic, not an accepted result; OUTPUT_INVALID, result=null, usable=false, requires_review=true; preserve raw area and ratio, do not clamp, epsilon-expand domain or change the Tien table
normalization.scope: Internal S-11 data only; do not add RSA to final Candidate schema

numerical_acceptance_proposal.scope: Same selected atoms, coordinates, radii, probe and residue identity only; excludes model/context/experimental uncertainty
numerical_acceptance_proposal.equivalent_per_residue_absolute_sasa_err: 0.01 * Tien maximum for that residue; not a fixed area or a relative-RSA tolerance
numerical_acceptance_proposal.independent_reference: Biopython 1.88 ShrakeRupley with shared exact coordinates/ProtOr radii; 61440 points for the recorded sample, check convergence on each new reference sample
numerical_acceptance_proposal.reference_uncertainty: Convergence difference is empirical, not a rigorous error bound
numerical_acceptance_proposal.decision_consistency: No classification discrepancy at any consumed boundary, including RSA<0.20 and S-39 terminal means at 0.20/0.40; crossing requires review even if numerical budgets pass
must_also_pass: unique complete address mapping for compared positions
numerical_acceptance_proposal.source: reference_spec.json targets were written before the first study run; these are a proposed engineering error budget, not tolerances published by the paper or expert package
